external_uboot_boot_path_scope: A vendor recovery/reset-triggered external boot reached EmuELEC and EmulationStation. Exact U-Boot commands, MMC numbering, and load addresses remain unobserved.
notes: On 2026-10-23, the owner completed a physical external-media boot of the existing EmuELEC installation on the Vayava/Franklin box. HDMI video, the EmuELEC splash, EmulationStation collection loading, the frontend, and a RetroArch/libretro launch path and Cannonball display-calibration UI were observed. This verifies a compatible reference OS external boot path; it is not proof that a RetroVerse-built kernel, DTB, initramfs, or root filesystem boots. android_internal_storage_untouched=false records that fallback to Android after media removal has not yet been independently verified, not evidence of modification.
